nodes.name: notion
nodes.description: Create and query Notion database pages, get, archive and search pages, append blocks, upload files from binary data
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Work with Notion. Pick `resource` (databasePage, page, block) and `operation`: create a database page (`databaseId`, `title`), query a database (`databaseId`, optional `filterJson`), get or archive a page (`pageId`), search pages (`text`), or append paragraphs to a page (`blockId`, `text`). Files uploaded from binary data on the item: block `appendFile` adds an image, video, audio, PDF or file block; page `attachFile` adds to a Files property.

options.action: Upload binary data and append it as a file, image, video, audio or PDF block

options.name: Attach File

nodes.name: airtable
nodes.description: Create, upsert, get, search, update and delete Airtable records; upload and download attachments
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Read and write Airtable records in a table (`base` and `table` ids). Operations: `search` with an Airtable formula in `filterByFormula`, `get` / `deleteRecord` by record `id`, `create` / `update` / `upsert` with the record fields as a JSON object in `fieldsJson` (set `dataMode` to `json`). Attachments (resource `attachment`): `upload` sends the item's binary file (`binaryPropertyName`) to `attachmentField` of record `attachmentRecordId` (up to 5 MB); `download` returns each file of that field as binary data.

nodes.name: github
nodes.description: Create, edit, comment on and list issues; get repositories, releases and files; upload and download files and release assets
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Work with a GitHub repository (`owner`, `repository`). Issues: `create` (`title`, `body`), `get` / `edit` / `createComment` by `issueNumber`, `getAll` (filters by state and labels). Also get the repository, list releases, or read a file's text (`filePath`). Files and release assets move as binary data on the item: Download File, Create or Update File, Download Asset, Upload Asset, Download Archive.

nodes.name: jira
nodes.description: Create, get, search, update and transition Jira issues, add comments, and upload and download attachments
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Work with Jira issues. `getAll` searches with a JQL query in `jql`; `get` / `update` / `transition` take an `issueKey` like PROJ-123; `create` needs `project` and `issueType` ids and a `summary`; comments are added with resource `issueComment`, operation `add` and the `comment` text. Attachments (resource `issueAttachment`) are read from or written to binary data on the item: `add` uploads the file in `binaryPropertyName` to `attachmentIssueKey`, `get` downloads by `attachmentId`, `getAll` lists an issue's attachments (`download` fetches the files).

nodes.name: hubspot
nodes.description: Create or update, get and search HubSpot contacts; create deals; upload and download files
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Work with HubSpot CRM. Contacts: `upsert` by `email` (with optional names, phone, company), `get` by `contactId`, `search` with property filters. Deals: `create` with `dealName`, `stage`, `amount` and optional `associatedContactIds`. Files (Files API, needs the `files` scope): `upload` stores the item's binary file (`binaryPropertyName`) in the file manager, `get` returns a file's details by `fileId` and can download it as binary data.

credentialTypes.name: githubAppApi
credentialTypes.description: Act as a GitHub App installation instead of a person: create the app (Settings, Developer settings, GitHub Apps), generate a private key, install the app on the repositories. Install the app on the repositories the workflow uses. Permissions: Repository webhooks (read and write) for the webhook trigger, Contents, Issues and Pull requests (read, and write to change them) as the nodes need, and Metadata (read). Landflow signs a JWT with the key and trades it for an installation token (renewed before it expires). Leave Installation ID empty to find it from each repository.
